# capsule-cli manifests

`deal-view.manifest.json` is capsule-cli's `internal/cli/assets/deal-view.manifest.json`
(`capsulectl.deal-view/v0`, the presentation module of the page `deal report --html`
writes), copied unchanged from capsule-cli main at
`e9b1f21d` (`git show e9b1f21:internal/cli/assets/deal-view.manifest.json`).
`tests/test_receipt_module_slot.py` reads it to record how a registry chooses between it
and the receipt modules.
